outcome: PISQ-12 scores (Pelvic Organ Prolapse/Urinary Incontinence Sexual Questionnaire-12)
restrictions in sexual activity due to fear of urinary leakage
cohort: The study population comprised 2518 Dutch-speaking women aged 18 years or older, representing a cross section of the general Dutch population.
finding: The study established age-specific PISQ-12 reference scores, demonstrating that aging is associated with diminishing scores in sexual desire, sexual excitement, erection problems, and orgasm perception, while younger women (18-34 years) reported the lowest scores for pain during intercourse and limited sexual activity due to fear of urinary leakage.
